motivation: The first model has large errors and many false alerts in some culture dates. Test whether control-relative features reduce sensitivity to batch-dependent absolute activity levels.
data_target_splits: Exactly the prepared development cases, target, reserved identities, and purged culture-date splits of neuroforecast_selection_v1. No reserved outcomes are scored.
representation: For each readout at days 5 and 7, contrast = (mean raw - mean control)/(abs(mean raw)+abs(mean control)). Both zero gives zero; unavailable values remain missing. Include the original missing fractions, two normalized network-spike readouts and log10 dose.
activity_coordination_baseline: The same Extra Trees learner with day-5/day-7 contrasts for mean firing rate, mean correlation, active electrodes, actively bursting electrodes, and network-spike count; plus the two normalized network-spike readouts and concentration.
hyperparameters: Unchanged from the first protocol: Extra Trees 256 trees, depth 12, leaf size 4, seed 20260920; Ridge alpha 10 with training-only imputation/scaling.
primary_metric: Unchanged macro-culture-date MAE, with comparisons to every original baseline and the new ablations.
interpretation: This is model development informed by the first result, not independent validation. Preserve and report the first result. One bounded representation comparison is planned; do not tune it using the reserved batches.
